title: Nightbane pack
wikitext:
The Nightbane are a clan of [[worgen]] that roam [[Duskwood]]. Their most prominent presence is in [[Brightwood Grove]], west of [[Darkshire]], but they are said to have come from [[Roland's Doom]], a cave to the south. It is there that a group of miners found a mysterious scythe jutting from the cave wall, and when it was removed, the worgen spontaneously began to appear. The scythe is suspected to be the [[Scythe of Elune]].
